guards.name: design_before_code
guards.rule: Product source remains read-only until the user confirms the high-fidelity proposal.

guards.name: no_fake_course_data
guards.rule: The mockup must not invent learning progress, payment flow, current lesson persistence, or purchase state.

guards.name: task_local_only
guards.rule: Writes are limited to .codex/tasks/course-catalog-ux mockups/outputs and advisor state.

guards.name: open_portfolio_protected
guards.rule: Open portfolio data and production runtime data are not read, written, migrated, recalculated, copied, or deployed.

guards.name: separate_authorization
guards.rule: Any dev/prod deployment, backend/API/database change, payment work, external publishing, or production-data action requires separate same-turn authorization.
